Careful — the dates were moved. The original plan was **Dec 8–10** at the Austin office [9], but on Nov 16 Victor Lindqvist (QSA, Ardent) asked to move the on-site to **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17** because the second assessor had a conflict the week of Dec 7, and Shira Ben-Ami confirmed ("Please send updated invites") [2]. Avi Kessler's Slack reminder of Nov 17 still says Dec 8–10 [5], but that appears to predate the agreed change — the email exchange is the authoritative source.

So book your flight for **Dec 15–17 in Austin** (the Dec 1 evidence-package deadline is unchanged) [2]. You may want to double-check with Shira or Avi given the mixed messages.
